what: On first open, a cover card in the center (logo · name text with only the font changed, etc.) flips every .1s, and the 7th and 14th hold for .4s and .8s. At 4s the hero panel hidden above drops in over .3s and covers the last cover, and .7s later the black photo brightens and the headline · text turn on — once per session

options.[data-fx-part=card]: Cover card (child). Stacked and shown one at a time in turn. The last card is --fx-last (default 1.587) times
options.at: Time (s) when the panel comes down, default 4 (if the cards finish later, after that)
options.dur: Descend, brighten, and turn-on duration (s), default .3
options.lag: Time to brighten and switch on after coming down (s), default .7
options.drop: Page element css that comes down from above — starts above by its own height plus the distance to the top of the screen
options.dark: CSS of the element that starts black (brightness 0) and brightens
options.show: CSS for elements that start transparent and fade in (header, News text, control buttons)
options.once: Once-per-session key name, default page. none means every time it opens
options.fx:done: Event the element fires when everything finishes — start auto-advance or typing here

use:
×16
— In the DOM before the hero (.hero)
note: The panel covering the card is a matter of DOM order: give the veil no z-index and place the falling panel after the veil. If the panel has a CSS transition (transform, filter), turn it off meanwhile so the values match (transition: none on the panel while is-on).

from.where: index.js text splash (original splashInit — swap the 16 splash images with 0s duration .1s, 7th·14th at .4·.8s, at 4s .imgs y: -(height + top margin) → 0 .3s, at 4.7s figure brightness 0→1 · header·news·controls opacity 0→1 .3s, CustomEase 0.22,0.61,0.35,1, sessionStorage splashed)
